ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Amazon could buy up to $60 billion of Qualcomm AI data-center products
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reports Amazon and Qualcomm are expanding a custom AI-inference silicon/data-center relationship that can include up to roughly $60 billion of products, plus 1.6 Tbps optical-connectivity work; Qualcomm also granted Amazon a warrant tied to the arrangement.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Confirms hyperscaler AI capex remains broad and accelerates custom-inference silicon and optical-networking competition beyond Nvidia/AMD.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AMD CFO says AI addressable market could reach $2–3 trillion by 2030
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: AMD CFO Jean Hu highlighted strong GPU and CPU demand, said AI infrastructure remains early in its investment cycle, and projected more than 80% year-over-year CPU-business growth in the second half of 2026.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Supports AMD's +5.91% session gain and the view that AI compute demand is broadening beyond a single supplier.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: TSMC and ASML advance large-format High-NA EUV photomask initiative
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: TSMC and ASML announced work on 12-inch photomasks for High-NA EUV, targeting a pilot line around 2031 and system readiness around 2033; TSMC plans High-NA high-volume manufacturing for advanced nodes beginning around 2030.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Long-horizon positive for advanced-node productivity, foundry leadership and AI-chip manufacturing economics.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Apple September 9 launch becomes a major on-device-AI test
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple's September 9 event is expected to be the first major product showcase under CEO John Ternus, with investors focused on foldable-iPhone execution and a Siri/Apple Intelligence revamp amid intensifying China competition.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: The event is a near-term catalyst for Apple and suppliers; weak AI differentiation could keep pressure on premium-device share and valuation.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: No new standalone higher-impact company-specific announcement outweighed the day's sector rotation
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Nvidia fell 2.01% even as SOX rose 1.92%, while Microsoft fell 1.15% with the software sector; the divergence is more important than manufacturing a weakly sourced company-specific headline.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Leadership is broadening from Nvidia toward AMD, custom silicon, foundry and connectivity while application software faces new AI-disruption questions.

breaking_news.headline: WTI settles at $93.03 as Houthi attacks hit Saudi energy sites
breaking_news.summary: Reuters reported WTI settled at a six-week high of $93.03 and Brent at $97.92 after Iran-aligned Houthi attacks damaged Saudi energy facilities and injured dozens, while Hormuz disruptions remain a supply risk.
breaking_news.market_impact: Oil-to-inflation-to-yields is the dominant macro risk into PPI/CPI; a hotter inflation path could push Fed expectations more hawkish and compress equity multiples.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: High-multiple Taiwan tech faces valuation pressure, while energy/shipping themes may receive a relative tailwind.

breaking_news.headline: Wall Street falls as oil and rates rise, but semiconductors diverge positively
breaking_news.summary: S&P 500 fell 0.58%, Dow 1.18% and Nasdaq 0.32%, while SOX gained 1.92%. Software names weakened as GPT-6 Astra revived concerns that general AI agents could compete with specialized application software.
breaking_news.market_impact: The tape shows internal rotation rather than a uniform tech selloff: energy/chips/custom silicon are stronger, software and rate-sensitive groups weaker.

breaking_news.headline: Taiwan cash and TX futures retreat after the prior surge
breaking_news.summary: TAIEX closed 47,105.78, down 220.49 points (-0.47%). September TX regular session closed 46,980, down 482 points (-1.02%), while foreign net futures OI expanded to about -82,262 contracts.
breaking_news.market_impact: Local AI momentum is still elevated, but foreign-index-futures hedging increased and leaves Taiwan sensitive to oil, U.S. yields and U.S. inflation data.

earnings_summary.last_24h: ServiceTitan beat Q2 EPS/revenue expectations but guided Q3 revenue slightly below consensus and fell sharply after hours; Casey's posted strong fiscal-Q1 EPS/revenue but inside same-store sales were softer; Braze grew Q2 revenue about 26% but Q3 EPS guidance trailed consensus. The read-through is that growth remains healthy but forward guidance must clear high expectations.
earnings_summary.guidance_watch: Oracle's prior Q1 FY2027 guidance calls for total revenue +27% to +29% YoY in USD, cloud revenue +58% to +64%, and non-GAAP EPS $1.72-$1.76. Adobe previously guided Q3 revenue to roughly $6.67-$6.72B and non-GAAP EPS $6.05-$6.10.

narration_points: 美股在Labor Day後重新開市，但油價與殖利率壓力主導：S&P 500跌0.58%、Dow跌1.18%、Nasdaq跌0.32%，VIX升至15.72。
WTI正式結算升到93.03美元、Brent逼近100美元；中東能源設施受攻擊讓市場重新交易能源通膨與Fed升息風險。
10年期美債約4.791%，已位於52週區間約96.8%的極高位置；DXY反而回落至98.80，顯示美元走弱主要受到日圓與亞洲貨幣走強影響。
科技內部不是全面轉弱：SOX逆勢漲1.92%，AMD大漲5.91%、TSM ADR漲2.35%，但NVIDIA跌2.01%，顯示AI領導權正從單一GPU向CPU、客製晶片、晶圓代工與高速互連擴散。
Amazon與Qualcomm最高可達約600億美元的AI資料中心合作，是今天AI CapEx沒有降溫的最強驗證之一；TSMC與ASML的High-NA EUV合作則強化長期先進製程護城河。
另一方面，OpenAI GPT-6 Astra讓Salesforce、ServiceNow等軟體股承壓，市場開始區分『AI基礎設施受益者』與『可能被AI代理取代的應用軟體』。
台股9月8日收47105.78點、下跌0.47%，9月台指期日盤收46980、跌1.02%，外資淨空單擴大至約82262口；最新9月9日歸屬夜盤正式終值在截止時尚未由TAIFEX官方頁獨立驗證，因此canonical保留null。
今天先看Apple 9月9日產品發表與美國雇主成本；接著9月10日PPI、Oracle與Adobe，再到9月11日CPI，將決定AI強勁基本面能否抵銷更高油價與更高利率。
